gui.reason: The combined season_cap build option enables the calendar, gate, 2026 schedule resources and allocator. Basic and Advanced leave it off; Experimental enables it. EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED.

input_constraints: Pinned USA executable and a complete allocator union.

Recognized complete season owners; base year 2004 or 2026. The executable-only CLI cannot install or certify external regular/preseason templates; use the combined 2026 image build for the shipped matching resources.
Current dates encode year minus 2000; historical/templates retain their source context. No automatic migration of ambiguous older wrapped dates.
Extracted executable only, at most 12,300,288 bytes; output must be a new file. Full owner union must be reserved before any allocator owner is installed.
portme: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED: Noah must witness natural rollovers, boot and save/reload at 2053, 2098..2101, 2104 and indices 127/128; see ASTRA_CALENDAR_ENGINE_REPORT.md.
Current schedules encode year minus 2000. Historical/template paths keep their source context; ambiguous wrapped old saves and permanent century archives are not migrated.

Schedule rule follows the shipped template: opening Thursday is 77 days before the fourth Thursday in November; preseason begins 35 days earlier; postseason uses fixed day offsets from that opening. This is not a future real-world NFL schedule prediction.

public_distribution.rule: Do not distribute generated executables, discs or saves.

runtime.scope: Bounded isolated x86 instructions and synthetic-league generators only. No naturally advanced franchise, loader or save/reload gameplay witness.

fields.allowed: Boolean. The combined Build option implies calendar_engine, season_2026 and xbe_space; off in Basic/Advanced, on in Experimental.
fields.name: season_cap

selectors.notes: season_cap is the existing combined image-build control, not a save edit. The backend CLI retains the recognized executable starting year and writes a new XBE copy; it does not install disc schedule resources or migrate saves.

source_container.resource: Pinned date, live DOB, season-label and completion-gate sites; nfl2k5_calendar owns 1,024 RX and 2,048 immutable RO bytes, with no new writable or persistent state.
